name: Wraithbane Edge
summary:
The blade of this silvery dagger gleams, reflecting light at impossible angles, despite its translucence. You almost expect your hand to go right through when touching it, but you easily find that it’s both solid and sharp.

This ethereal dagger can hit the very souls of ghostly creatures and cleaves through forces that animate the undead. While still effective against the living, its main application is disposing of those who walk (or hover) the earth beyond their natural lives.

name: Stinglash
summary:
This whip is formed from the headless body of a long serpent, its tail ending in a barb akin to a scorpion’s stinger. Its shiny, brown and black scales are thick and smooth, while the barb at its end is covered in tiny hairs that excrete a milky liquid.

This weapon was made to cause excruciating pain with its poisonous strikes, allowing its wielder to get the upper hand in battle.

name: Flameguard Gauntlets
summary:
These black gauntlets have a crimson sheen and are covered in etchings of stylized flame. They radiate warmth which flares into a scorching heat upon impact.

These gauntlets were crafted by dwarven blacksmiths to heat and handle metal without the use of a forge. After being quite effective in ending a drunken brawl, they have since become standard equipment among certain groups of warriors and monks.

name: Iron Mask of Stoicism
summary:
This solid iron mask has small slits cut for eyes, nostrils, and a mouth. It has several leather straps with iron buckles to fasten it in place.

Masks of Stoicism are used by some monasteries to temper emotions and promote tranquility. Prolonged use during meditation can fully strip one of their emotions, which the monks see as the first step towards true enlightenment.

name: Owl Cloak
summary:
This dark, feather-lined cloak drapes heavily across the shoulders, its hood cut to have the appearance of a horned owl’s silhouette. It’s reinforced with leather around the collar and along the cape. The hood itself is made of a durable and flexible fabric.

This cowl is used by scouts and sentries at night and in caves, but it’s ability to intensify light makes its use limited in daytime or in well-lit areas.

name: Shield of Ranged Reflection
summary:
The face of this small, round shield is made of polished silver that never blemishes. The face is so reflective that it could be used as a mirror.

Shields of Ranged Reflection are commonly used by soldiers to retaliate against archers and mages while they approach. Just wielding the shield can be enough of a deterrent to prevent ranged attacks.

name: Flickerbolt Dart
summary:
This golden dart is about a foot long with a simple, elegant design. It’s white metal fins have the jagged edge of a lightning bolt. Its surprisingly light for its size.

Flickerbolt darts are forged of electrum plated mithril in the heart of a massive thunderstorm. The primal forces of electricity are channeled into the dart, which then infuses the wielder when used.

name: Merfolk Trident
summary:
This large, bronze trident has an oceanic design with embossed coral, seaweed, and fish along the haft and prongs. The tip of each prong is shaped like a thin, spiraling seashell.

Merfolk Tridents were originally crafted by merfolk to allow them to travel on land as either envoys or raiders. Some have been granted to humanoid settlements to allow envoys into merfork civilizations.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
Melee Weapon, Spear Style
1 Piercing damage
Versatile, Reach

WHILE ATTUNED
MERFOLK TRANSFORMATION (1)
When you equip this weapon, you can breath underwater and undergo a transformation depending on your base form:
• If you have a fish tail instead of legs, your tail splits in 2 to become legs. You can breathe air and your Speed becomes equal to your Swim Speed, but you’re Slowed when swimming. You can now equip foot items.
• If you have legs, your legs merge together into a fish tail. You gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed, but are Slowed when moving on the ground. Any pants or boots you were wearing fall off and you can’t equip anything on your feet.
• If you have neither, you grow a fish tail and gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
The transformation ends when you unequip the weapon.

name: Raccoon Shifter Mask
summary:
A small fur raccoon mask with a leather strap.

Shifter Masks are commonly used by scouts and spies who aren’t able to magically shift on their own. Raccoons are popular among those who work in at night with their strong night vision and climbing abilities making it easy to spy from rooftops or trees.

name: Battlemage Staff
summary:
This ironwood staff has a remarkably simple design. It has a durable leather handle and adamantine caps on both of its tips.

This staff was designed for battle with function over design. These staffs have crushed through much more ornate wizard staves or champion shields in the many wars they were used.

name: Floating Protector
summary:
This sentient tower shield is embossed by a massive moving face of a ruggedly handsome half dwarf with a plumed helm. It’s overly protective to a condescending degree, unable to fathom that anything but proper, heavy armor can provide sufficient safety.

Despite being quite helpful in combat, the Floating Protector has changed hands many times due to sheer exasperation. It’s longest owners have been nobles who see its concerns as evidence of their own importance.
mechanics:
STATISTICS
Heavy Shield
+2 PD, +1 AD
DisADV on Agility Checks

DANCING (SHIELD) (3)
You can use a Minor Action to cause the Shield to begin hovering in the air. The Shield ceases to hover if you grab it or you end your turn more than 5 Spaces from it.

While it’s within 5 Spaces of you and hovering, you can take the Object Action to move it to any Space within 5 Spaces of you. When you do, you can choose for it to protect a creature within 1 Space of it, following them as they move. A protected creature benefits from the Shield’s benefits (such as PDR, EDR, and Defense increases) even if it’s already wielding a Shield. A creature can only gain the bonuses of one Dancing Shield at a time (its choice). They can spend a Minor Action to change which wielded Shield to benefit from.

You can perform Maneuvers with the Shield as if you were standing in its Space.

MINOR SENTIENCE (2)
The item has sentience with the following statistics:
• It has a Charisma of 3 and an Intelligence of -2.
• It has 10 Spaces of hearing, sight, and Telepathy.
• It can read and speak Common and 1 additional language.
